item.title: Texas Tech opens home play with sweep over UAlbany
item.description: Texas Tech baseball got to play ball in the friendly confines of Rip Griffin Park for this first time this weekend. After a rocky start in Arlington, the Red Raiders put together an impressive four-game sweep of UAlbany in front of their home crowd.

item.title: Large crowds gathered for State Rep. James Talarico Lubbock rally
